digest: No test files or test suites exist in the repository; unit test requirement Q1 and all behavioral requirements (S1–S7, C1–C2, T1–T3) lack test coverage.
coverageGapsSuspected: Requirement Q1: No unit tests exist in the repository to verify S, C, or T requirements.
Requirement S1: No test coverage for stop intent detection via disk or foreground AbortSignal.
Requirement S2: No test coverage for WorkflowStopRequested error name and message format.
Requirement S3: No test coverage for pollMs default (50ms) and minimum floor (10ms).
Requirement S4: No test coverage for disk read failure handling in signal vs throwIfWorkflowStopRequested.
Requirement S5: No test coverage ensuring no disk reads occur after dispose().
Requirement S6: No test coverage for isWorkflowStopRequestedError checking name only, not message.
Requirement S7: No test coverage for unbinding foreground signal and cleaning up empty map entries.
Requirement C1: No test coverage for exact provider cancellation strings (aborted, AbortError, ABORT_ERR).
Requirement C2: No test coverage for recursive JSON content parsing and infinite recursion protection.
Requirement T1: No test coverage for mapping completed run with degradation to completed_degraded.
Requirement T2: No test coverage for direct-dynamic unreadable control.json mapped to completed_without_semantic_result.
Requirement T3: No test coverage for outputRetryAttempts and launchRetryAttempts summing all task retries.
